meta.title: Lba Cra And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the LBA Capital Projects Fund Budget for Fiscal Year 2025-26 to a future date for action.
votes.description: The LBA board closed the public hearing on the FY 2025-26 Capital Projects Fund budget, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries, and referred the item for future action.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the LBA and convene as the CRA.
votes.description: Procedural motion to end the Local Building Authority meeting and begin the Community Reinvestment Agency meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the CRA Budget for Fiscal Year 2025-26 to a future date for action.
votes.description: The CRA board closed the public hearing on the FY 2025-26 Community Reinvestment Agency budget and referred the item for future action.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the CRA and convene as the City Council.
votes.description: Procedural motion to end the Community Reinvestment Agency meeting and begin the Salt Lake City Council meeting.

votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of February 4, 2025.
votes.description: The Council approved the official work session minutes from the February 4, 2025 meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items G1 through G15 to a future date for action.
votes.description: The Council closed the combined public hearing on all FY 2025-26 Mayor's Recommended Budget items (G1–G15), including the city budget, library fund, tax levy, fee schedule, compensation plans, union MOUs, code amendments, CIP, and UTA interlocal agreement, and referred them for future action.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 30 of 2025, approving a $200,000 loan for Hruskas LLC from the Economic Development Loan Fund.
votes.description: The Council approved a $200,000 EDLF loan to Hruskas LLC, a kolache restaurant at 1751 South 1100 East, to support job creation and retention.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 14 of 2025, adopting the bond parameters and recognizing the date to set a public hearing on the bond issuance for July 1, 2025.
votes.description: The Council adopted a parameters resolution authorizing the issuance of up to $700 million in Airport Revenue Bonds Series 2025 for capital improvements to Salt Lake City International Airport, and set a public hearing for July 1, 2025.

The Council approved the full consent agenda, including setting public hearing dates for Airport Revenue Bonds and a zoning map amendment at 128 North N Street, approving Grant Holding Account Items (Batch No. 5) for FY 2024-25, and confirming the board appointment of Aleksei Hernandez-Nietling to the Racial Equity in Policing Commission.
